narrative.intro: Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk has $519M in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk received 10 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $51.9M. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk obligations are up 75.5% year over year. These figures reflect contract obligations; largest-award and expiring-contract entries in source tables would be total contract values rather than obligations. Current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date.
